title: 136. Burst Balloons

examples.explanation: One optimal order is 1, 5, 3, 8, which yields 167 coins.

hints: Choosing the first balloon is awkward because its future neighbors are unknown; instead, choose the last balloon burst in an interval.
Pad the array with a value of 1 at each end and let dp[left][right] be the best result for that closed interval.
Try every index as the last balloon in each interval, building answers from shorter intervals to longer ones.
